records.text: Tony Erpenbeck tried from federal prison to hire someone to murder a federal judge and retired prosecutor and to kidnap an FBI agent's children
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: OK, Tony Erpenbeck, that's dad, had been in a federal medical prison in Lexington for just a few months when he tried to hire someone to murder and kidnap the people connected with putting him and his son behind bars. ... He wanted then senior U.S. District Judge S. Arthur Spiegel and then retired Assistant U.S. Attorney Kathleen Brinkman killed. ... Tony (Tony Erpenbeck) also targeted an FBI agent's children.

verification.notes: Contemporaneous reporting confirms a federal indictment alleging Anthony Erpenbeck sought the murders of the judge and prosecutor and threatened kidnapping of an FBI agent's family members. The conduct is supported as a charged allegation, but the reviewed source does not establish conviction on those counts; the statement's unqualified wording overstates that distinction.

sources.title: Federal inmate indicted for threatening judge, prosecutor
sources.relevance: Contemporaneous report documents the indictment allegations involving murder and kidnapping threats, while preserving that they were charges.
